zh: 闪卡和测验合并成了一个「练习」页：进去以后在页内切换复习 / 测验，导航栏从六格收回五格，快捷键也跟着变成 Ctrl/Cmd+1…5。两件事本来就用同一套牌堆、同一份进度、同一组按键，却各占一格标签栏。顺带修掉安卓 12 以上冷启动时那一闪的青色状态栏——启动画面背景没声明，系统就用了出厂默认的青色，现在钉成和侧栏一致的深色。之前那一轮的新版式也都在：列表直接铺在纸面上、控件统一胶囊、八屏没有标题栏、词库页查询栏收成「搜索 + 一个筛选胶囊」。
en: Flashcards and quiz are now one Practice page: switch between review and quiz inside the page, and the navigation drops from six slots back to five, with the shortcuts following as Ctrl/Cmd+1…5. The two already shared one deck, one set of progress and one keyboard map, yet each held its own tab. Also fixed the flash of cyan on Android 12+ cold starts — the splash screen background was never declared, so the system fell back to its stock teal; it now matches the sidebar's dark frame. Everything from the previous round is still here: lists sitting directly on the paper, capsule controls, no title bars on any screen, and the words page query row folded into "search + one filter capsule".
